_comment: « حصّة القسم » — the DEFAULT class tests of lesson « اختزال كسر » (docs/architecture/CLASS_SESSION.md). `start` opens the hour: what the lesson stands on (a PGCD by Euclid, two fractions that are equal, a missing term of an equal fraction, two coprime numbers, a divisibility rule), then two questions of the NEW lesson (`teaser`: a fraction that cannot be reduced, the one number that reduces a fraction in one division — asked again at the end, with other numbers). `end` closes it on the four الكفاءات of the lesson (one item of the learning net, 4am.m1.r05), weighted as the bank weighs them (P1 4, P2 9, P3 94, P4 42 of its 149 questions): reducing in stages (P1: e6 — the fraction after ONE division by a common divisor; subtracting the same number and dividing one term only are its traps), recognising an irreducible fraction (P2: e1), the irreducible form by the PGCD (P3: e2, e3, e4, e5 — a fraction EQUAL to the right one but still reducible is the trap of e3, e4 and e5), the result of a calculation given irreducible (P4: e7, e8 — the unreduced result is the trap). `pool` holds more prepared questions a teacher may add to his own copy. The numbers are the platform's own: no pair of the lesson's exercise bank, none of the student's story (scripts/lesson-bank-numbers.mjs). Every question carries a `check` from which its answer is RE-COMPUTED by a test (defaultTests.test.js): a default test never ships a wrong answer. A class test never changes a student's progress.
